description: One application in full: the resume (titles, companies, dates, skills, summary), cover letter, your private notes, the conversation with the candidate and the ATS state. Contact details follow the candidate's choice. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

name: get_application
